import subprocess
# Check out base and see what Arrow.now() returns
result = subprocess.run(["git", "stash"], capture_output=True, text=True)

result = subprocess.run(["python", "-c", 
    "import arrow; import dateutil.tz as tz; import datetime; \n"
    "a = arrow.Arrow.now();\n"
    "print('Arrow.now tzinfo:', type(a._datetime.tzinfo), a._datetime.tzinfo);\n"
    "print('Expected:', type(datetime.datetime.now().replace(tzinfo=tz.tzlocal()).tzinfo));\n"
    "print('Equal?', a._datetime.tzinfo == datetime.datetime.now().replace(tzinfo=tz.tzlocal()).tzinfo)")],
    capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=30)
print(result.stdout)

# Restore
result = subprocess.run(["git", "stash", "pop"], capture_output=True, text=True)
